body:
🟠🐛 **Fix · bug: Files dropped while an import is running are silently discarded**

The `importing` doc comment (line 36) says "a second one waits for it", but `run` returns at once when `busy.current` is set (line 78), and it shows no toast. `useFileDrop` keeps the whole window as a drop target during an import (`use-file-drop.ts:40-46`). `importDropped` also skips the `busy` check until it reaches `run` (line 112). So if a user drops more videos while a large file is still copying, those videos are never imported, and the user gets no message. The only exception is the "ignored" toast for files that aren't videos. Fix this by queueing the second call so it runs after the current one (what the comment promises), or by showing a toast such as "an import is already running" when it is refused. Then update the comment to match.

🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: A finished import navigates to Prepare even after the user has left Prepare**

`onImported` always runs `relist().then(() => navigate(preparePath(...)))`. Nothing checks whether Prepare is still mounted when the import resolves. `useImportVideos.run` (use-import-videos.ts:82-83) awaits the IPC and then calls `report` → `onImported` with no mounted guard. The Back button stays enabled during an import (destination-list.tsx:62; only the footer is `disabled={importing}`), and so does "From your Library" (prepare-drop-zone.tsx:39).

So here is the failure: you drop a large video on Prepare, click "Back to recording" or "From your Library" while the copy runs, and when the copy finishes the app takes you back to `/prepare/<new>`. The data router's `navigate` still works after the component unmounts.

You could drop the navigation once the hook unmounts, for example with a mounted ref cleared in a `useEffect` cleanup. In that case the Library's usual "is in your Library" toast would fit better. Or disable Back while `importing` is true.

🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: Centered flex container with overflow-y: auto can clip the top of the zone**

`.wrap` sets `align-items: center` and `overflow-y: auto` (lines 6 and 9). When `.zone` is taller than the column (short window, large font size, or long Spanish copy wrapping), the flex item overflows equally above and below. The part above the scroll origin can't be reached by scrolling, so the icon and title get cut off. One fix is `align-items: safe center`. Another is to drop `align-items` and give `.zone` `margin: auto`: auto margins fall back to 0 on overflow, so the content stays reachable.

🟠📝 **Fix · docs: Limit says drops on other pages still navigate, but Prepare now handles drops**

This PR also adds `usePrepareImport` (`features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:55`), which calls `useFileDrop` while Prepare is mounted, and `prepare-page.tsx:81` uses it. So it is no longer true that a drop on any page other than the Library falls through to Electron's default. Change the limit to say that drops are caught on the Library and Prepare, and that every other page still navigates. You could also link to [prepare-drop-zone](./prepare-drop-zone).

🟡📝 **Consider · docs: Prepare drop body lists only MP4 or MOV**

`prepare.dropBody` says "MP4 or MOV from anywhere". The import accepts `.mp4`, `.mov`, `.m4v` and `.webm` (`src/shared/import-video.ts:12`), and the Library strings (`importReasonUnsupported`, `importDropIgnored`) list all four. A user who has a WebM may think Prepare won't take it. Consider listing the same four formats here. The same applies to es.json line 907.

🟡❓ **Consider · question: The copyright holder (Cristian Sotomayor) is not the party the CLA licenses (Niway S.A.C.)**

The README names Cristian Sotomayor as the copyright holder, with Niway S.A.C. as publisher. CLA.md, though, grants the relicensing rights to Niway (CLA.md:5, §2), and open-source.md says the CLA keeps "one owner". If the existing code belongs to a person and the contributions are licensed to a company, the relicensing rights sit with two parties. Is there an assignment or license from the author to Niway that makes Niway the single owner? If so, could the README or CLA say so? If not, should the CLA name the actual copyright holder?

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Obsolete: #467 replaced `prepare-drop-zone.module.css` with `pages/export/export-drop-zone.module.css`, whose `.wrap` is no longer a scroll box (no `overflow-y`, so the Library picker below its button is not clipped). The centred-overflow clipping described here cannot happen in that file.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

This text comes from #438 (licensing + CLA), merged into this branch from main, not from this PR. Who holds the copyright, and whether an assignment from the author to Niway S.A.C. is needed or the CLA should name the author, is an open owner decision tracked in NIW2-569; the README and CLA will change there once it is decided.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Fixed in [`d1d24c29`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/d1d24c29d39690c46bd5a6d2a38f57beb5136fd0) on #471 (top of the stack): `run` now queues an import behind the running one instead of returning, and `importing` stays true until the queue drains; a test drops twice during a pending import and sees both imported in order.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Fixed in [`6c444e55`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/6c444e559111cfd17620fcc30796139f00c2dea6) on #471 (top of the stack): `usePrepareImport` tracks whether Export is mounted; when the import ends after the user left, it does not navigate and shows the Library's "is in your Library" toast with Open instead (new test).

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Fixed in [`450c9100`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/450c910079c5692c55a314de82f77fc798135608) on #471 (top of the stack): import-video.md now says the ways in are on Export, drops are caught only while Export is open, and the code table points at `export-drop-zone.tsx`.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Fixed in [`ac52d18e`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/ac52d18ebd55e1ece437bab0b9ed17e97afd9984) on #471 (top of the stack): `export.dropBody` now lists MP4, MOV, M4V and WebM (en and es); the unused `prepare.dropBody` is removed.
